title: VCS Repository Scan Workflow
activity_flow: Call getDriver() to resolve VCS driver
[Decision] Is driver type explicitly set in repoConfig?
YES → Instantiate that driver class directly
NO  → Iterate drivers: call driver::supports(io, config, url) [strict=false]
[Decision] Any driver returns true? YES → use it
NO  → Iterate drivers: call driver::supports(io, config, url, true) [lenient]
[Decision] Any driver returns true? YES → use it | NO → return null → throw InvalidArgumentException
Call driver->initialize() on selected driver (e.g. GitLabDriver parses URL regex, sets scheme/origin/namespace/repo)
YES → call driver->getComposerInformation(rootId) → set packageName from data['name']
[Decision] Valid tag? NO → log warning, continue
[Decision] data['version'] set? YES → normalize it | NO → use tag as version
[Decision] version_normalized matches parsedTag? NO → log warning, continue
[Decision] Package with same name+version already exists? YES → log conflict, continue
preProcess(driver, data, identifier) → fills dist/source from driver if missing
[Exception] TransportException → record in versionTransportExceptions['tags']; rethrow if 401/403/429/5xx
Reorder: root identifier branch first if it had composer.json
[Decision] Valid branch? NO → log warning, continue
Compute version string: 'dev-{branch}' for dev/default-alias or semver x.y.x pattern
Set data['version'] and data['version_normalized'] from branch name
[Decision] Is this the root identifier branch? YES → set data['default-branch']=true
[Decision] ValidatingArrayLoader warnings present? YES → throw InvalidPackageException
[Exception] TransportException → record in versionTransportExceptions['branches']; rethrow if 401/403/429/5xx
[Exception] Generic Exception → branchErrorOccurred=true; log error; continue
[Decision] No packages loaded at all? → throw InvalidRepositoryException
key_methods: VcsRepository::initialize() — main scan orchestrator; calls getDriver(), iterates tags and branches
VcsRepository::getDriver() — resolves driver by type or URL matching via supports(); calls driver->initialize()
VcsRepository::validateTag(string) — VersionParser::normalize(); returns normalized string or false
VcsRepository::validateBranch(string) — VersionParser::normalizeBranch() + parseConstraints(); returns string or false
VcsRepository::preProcess(driver, data, id) — fills dist/source via driver->getDist()/getSource() if absent
VcsDriver::getComposerInformation(identifier) — checks infoCache; reads/writes Cache; calls getBaseComposerInformation()
VcsDriver::getBaseComposerInformation(identifier) — calls getFileContent('composer.json', id); parses JSON; adds change date
GitLabDriver::supports(io, config, url) — static; checks configured gitlab-domains against URL
key_relationships: VcsRepository uses VersionParser for tag/branch validation and normalization
VcsRepository uses ArrayLoader (or ValidatingArrayLoader) to load Package from data array
VcsRepository optionally uses VersionCacheInterface to skip re-fetching known identifiers
VcsDriver uses HttpDownloader for remote file fetching
VcsDriver uses Cache for caching composer.json content by SHA1 identifier
conditions_and_branches: Driver selection: explicit type → strict URL match → lenient URL match → null/error
Tag processing: cache hit | cache miss/empty | invalid name | no composer.json | version mismatch | package conflict | success
Branch processing: invalid name | cache hit | cache miss/empty | no composer.json | is root branch | success | TransportException | generic error
ValidatingArrayLoader additional check on branches only (not tags)
important_notes: The workflow is driven by VcsRepository::initialize(). Driver resolution happens lazily via getDriver() which also calls driver->initialize(). Tags are scanned first, then branches (root branch promoted to front). The 'release-' prefix is stripped from tag names only. Branches always use dev-versioning. VersionCache bypasses HTTP calls for known identifier/version pairs. Driver cleanup() is called after all scanning completes. An InvalidRepositoryException is thrown if zero valid packages are loaded.
